local004.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) as total_payment
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as NUM_ORDERS,
        AVG(ot.total_payment) as AVG_PAYMENT_PER_ORDER,
        GREATEST(1.0, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) - MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)))) / 86400.0) / 7.0) as lifespan_weeks
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_totals ot ON o.order_id = ot.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT customer_unique_id, NUM_ORDERS, AVG_PAYMENT_PER_ORDER
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY AVG_PAYMENT_PER_ORDER DESC
LIMIT 3

local073.sql:
WITH orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id, customer_id) as row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_customer_orders
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        CAST(TRIM(UNNEST(SPLIT(r.toppings, ','))) AS INTEGER) as topping_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN pizza_recipes r ON o.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
),
exclusions AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        CAST(TRIM(UNNEST(SPLIT(o.exclusions, ','))) AS INTEGER) as exclusion_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND o.exclusions != ''
),
extras AS (
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        CAST(TRIM(UNNEST(SPLIT(o.extras, ','))) AS INTEGER) as extra_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.extras IS NOT NULL AND o.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        st.row_id,
        st.order_id,
        st.customer_id,
        st.pizza_id,
        st.topping_id
    FROM standard_toppings st
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM exclusions e 
        WHERE e.row_id = st.row_id AND e.exclusion_id = st.topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        o.row_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        e.extra_id as topping_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN extras e ON o.row_id = e.row_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        topping_id,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, topping_id
),
topping_names AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.row_id,
        tc.order_id,
        tc.customer_id,
        tc.pizza_id,
        tc.topping_id,
        tc.cnt,
        t.topping_name,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || t.topping_name ELSE t.topping_name END as display_name,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_group
    FROM topping_counts tc
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON tc.topping_id = t.topping_id
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        tn.row_id,
        tn.order_id,
        tn.customer_id,
        tn.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        string_agg(tn.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY tn.sort_group, tn.topping_name) as ingredients
    FROM topping_names tn
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON tn.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    GROUP BY tn.row_id, tn.order_id, tn.customer_id, tn.pizza_id, pn.pizza_name
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients as FINAL_INGREDIENTS
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id

local075.sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.page_name,
        e.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
visits_with_purchase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
product_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.page_name,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 1 THEN 1 END) AS PRODUCT_VIEWS,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) AS ADDED_TO_CART,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN pe.event_type = 2 AND vwp.visit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS PURCHASES
    FROM product_events pe
    LEFT JOIN visits_with_purchase vwp ON pe.visit_id = vwp.visit_id
    GROUP BY pe.page_name
)
SELECT 
    PRODUCT_VIEWS,
    ADDED_TO_CART,
    PURCHASES,
    ADDED_TO_CART - PURCHASES AS LEFT_IN_CART
FROM product_stats
ORDER BY page_name

local130.sql:
WITH english_completed AS (
    SELECT ss.StudentID, s.StudLastName, ss.Grade
    FROM Student_Schedules ss
    JOIN Students s ON ss.StudentID = s.StudentID
    JOIN Classes c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2 AND sub.SubjectCode LIKE 'ENG%'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        StudLastName,
        Grade,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completed ec2 WHERE ec2.Grade >= ec.Grade) AS rank_num,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completed) AS total
    FROM english_completed ec
),
with_quintile AS (
    SELECT 
        StudLastName,
        Grade,
        CASE 
            WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
            WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
            WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
            WHEN 1.0 * rank_num / total <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
            ELSE 'Fifth'
        END AS Quintile
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT StudLastName, Grade
FROM with_quintile
ORDER BY 
    CASE Quintile 
        WHEN 'First' THEN 1 
        WHEN 'Second' THEN 2 
        WHEN 'Third' THEN 3 
        WHEN 'Fourth' THEN 4 
        WHEN 'Fifth' THEN 5 
    END,
    Grade DESC

local131.sql:
SELECT 
    ms.StyleID,
    ms.StyleName,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 1 END) AS FirstPreferenceCount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 1 END) AS SecondPreferenceCount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1 END) AS ThirdPreferenceCount
FROM Musical_Styles ms
LEFT JOIN Musical_Preferences mp ON ms.StyleID = mp.StyleID
GROUP BY ms.StyleID, ms.StyleName
ORDER BY ms.StyleID

local133.sql:
WITH style_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.StyleName,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 3
            WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 2
            WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1
        END) AS total_weighted_score
    FROM Musical_Preferences mp
    JOIN Musical_Styles ms ON mp.StyleID = ms.StyleID
    GROUP BY ms.StyleName
),
avg_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_weighted_score) AS avg_total
    FROM style_scores
)
SELECT 
    ss.StyleName,
    ABS(ss.total_weighted_score - a.avg_total) AS AbsoluteDifference
FROM style_scores ss
CROSS JOIN avg_score a
ORDER BY ss.StyleName

local170.sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
years AS (
    SELECT 0 as year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
check_points AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        l.gender,
        y.year_offset,
        date_trunc('year', CAST(ft.first_term_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL (y.year_offset) YEAR) + INTERVAL (1) YEAR - INTERVAL (1) DAY AS check_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    JOIN legislators l ON ft.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN years y
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.id_bioguide,
        cp.gender,
        lt.state,
        cp.year_offset,
        cp.check_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cp.check_date AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= cp.check_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_retained
    FROM check_points cp
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON cp.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY cp.id_bioguide, cp.gender, lt.state, cp.year_offset, cp.check_date
),
state_gender_year AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        year_offset,
        SUM(is_retained) as retained_count,
        COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM retention
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_offset
),
state_gender_qualifies AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        COUNT(*) as year_points_with_retention
    FROM state_gender_year
    WHERE retained_count > 0
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM state_gender_qualifies
WHERE gender IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
ORDER BY state

local201.sql:
SELECT 
    w1.words as word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w2.words) as anagram_count
FROM word_list w1
JOIN word_list w2 ON w1.words != w2.words
    AND w1.words IS NOT NULL AND w2.words IS NOT NULL
    AND length(w1.words) = length(w2.words)
    AND length(w1.words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND w1.words LIKE 'r%'
    AND (SELECT string_agg(c, '' ORDER BY c)
         FROM (SELECT substring(w1.words, n, 1) as c
               FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(1, length(w1.words))) as n) t2) t
        ) = (SELECT string_agg(c, '' ORDER BY c)
              FROM (SELECT substring(w2.words, n, 1) as c
                    FROM (SELECT unnest(generate_series(1, length(w2.words))) as n) t2) t
             )
GROUP BY w1.words
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT w2.words) >= 1
ORDER BY w1.words
LIMIT 10

local286.sql:
WITH seller_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity_sold,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as average_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
category_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pt.product_category_name_english,
        COUNT(*) as category_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pt.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT 
    ss.seller_id,
    ss.total_quantity_sold,
    ss.total_sales,
    ss.average_item_price,
    cr.product_category_name_english as top_categories_english
FROM seller_stats ss
JOIN category_ranked cr ON ss.seller_id = cr.seller_id AND cr.rn = 1
ORDER BY ss.total_quantity_sold DESC

local311.sql:
WITH constructor_year_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
driver_year_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) as driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id, res.driver_id
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM driver_year_points
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cy.year, cy.constructor_id, 
           cy.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_year_points cy
    JOIN best_driver bd ON cy.year = bd.year AND cy.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name, combined.year
FROM combined
JOIN constructors c ON combined.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY combined.combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

local335.sql:
WITH season_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(cs.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM season_constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
lowest_scorers AS (
    SELECT 
        scp.year,
        scp.constructor_id
    FROM season_constructor_points scp
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON scp.year = mps.year AND scp.total_points = mps.min_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        constructor_id,
        COUNT(*) as times_lowest
    FROM lowest_scorers
    GROUP BY constructor_id
    ORDER BY times_lowest DESC, constructor_id
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT c.name as CONSTRUCTOR_NAME
FROM constructor_counts cc
JOIN constructors c ON cc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cc.times_lowest DESC, cc.constructor_id

local360.sql:
WITH first_target AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_target_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT ft.session, 
           COUNT(CASE WHEN a.search_type IS NOT NULL AND a.search_type != '' THEN 1 END) as pre_count
    FROM first_target ft
    LEFT JOIN activity_log a ON ft.session = a.session AND a.stamp < ft.first_target_stamp
    GROUP BY ft.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_count) as min_pre_count FROM session_counts
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT sc.session
    FROM session_counts sc, min_count mc
    WHERE sc.pre_count = mc.min_pre_count
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT a.session, a.path, a.search_type,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.session ORDER BY a.stamp) as rn
    FROM activity_log a
    WHERE a.session IN (SELECT session FROM qualifying)
      AND a.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete')
)
SELECT session, path, search_type
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY session

local062.sql:
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_id,
        SUM(s.quantity_sold * (co.unit_price - co.unit_cost)) AS total_profit
    FROM sales s
    JOIN costs co ON s.prod_id = co.prod_id 
        AND s.time_id = co.time_id 
        AND s.promo_id = co.promo_id 
        AND s.channel_id = co.channel_id
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52770
        AND s.time_id >= '2021-12-01' 
        AND s.time_id <= '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
stats AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_p, MAX(total_profit) AS max_p FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.cust_id,
        cp.total_profit,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.total_profit = s.max_p THEN 10
            ELSE LEAST(10, FLOOR(1.0 * (cp.total_profit - s.min_p) / (s.max_p - s.min_p) * 10) + 1)
        END AS bucket
    FROM customer_profits cp, stats s
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS CUSTOMER_COUNT,
    MIN(total_profit) AS MIN_PROFIT_IN_BUCKET,
    MAX(total_profit) AS MAX_PROFIT_IN_BUCKET
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

local096.sql:
WITH movie_actors AS (
    SELECT m.MID,
           CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) as YEAR,
           COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID)) as actor_count,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_male,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.Gender IS NULL OR p.Gender = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_unknown
    FROM Movie m
    LEFT JOIN M_Cast mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
    LEFT JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY m.MID, m.year
),
yearly_stats AS (
    SELECT YEAR,
           COUNT(*) as TOTAL_MOVIES,
           SUM(CASE WHEN actor_count > 0 AND has_male = 0 AND has_unknown = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as exclusively_female_count
    FROM movie_actors
    GROUP BY YEAR
)
SELECT YEAR,
       TOTAL_MOVIES,
       ROUND(100.0 * exclusively_female_count / TOTAL_MOVIES, 2) as PERCENTAGE_EXCLUSIVELY_FEMALE
FROM yearly_stats
ORDER BY YEAR
